subject: Deadline clarification
text: I wanted to ask for clarification about the dates we mentioned earlier. Because of a travel disruption, my connection was delayed, and I did not get to review the shared notes until this morning. I understand the first submission is important, but I am not certain whether it is tied to the meeting schedule or to the individual checkpoint emails. If the deadline has moved quietly because of the venue change, could someone confirm the current expectation and let me know whether the group materials remain due at the same time? A short reply would be enough.
